blocks.text: Suppose a football game begins at 1:00 p.m. in New York. It is then 6:00 p.m. in London. Which time is correct? if an explosion occurred on a star, scientists on the earth would record th time it happened. But anyone traveling in another part of the universe in a different direction would identify the time differently. Thus there is no absolute time.

readingSentences.english: The oceans cover more than seventy percent of our planet's surface.
readingSentences.korean: 바다는 우리 지구 표면의 70% 이상을 덮고 있다.

readingSentences.english: They regulate global climate patterns and produce the majority of the oxygen we breathe.
readingSentences.korean: 바다는 지구의 기후 패턴을 조절하고 우리가 숨 쉬는 산소의 대부분을 생산한다.

readingSentences.english: Marine ecosystems support an astonishing variety of aquatic life.
readingSentences.korean: 해양 생태계는 놀랍도록 다양한 수생 생물들의 삶을 지탱해 준다.

readingSentences.english: Safeguarding the health of our seas is essential for the future of humanity.
readingSentences.korean: 바다의 건강을 지키는 것은 인류의 미래를 위해 필수 불가결한 일이다.
